title: Validate relay addresses
responsibility: Normalize an allowed relay origin and derive its host WebSocket endpoint.

inputs.name: relayOrigin.value
inputs.description: Optional URL limited to HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1, with no credentials, nonroot path, query or fragment.

inputs.name: relaySocketUrl.hostId
inputs.description: Host ID containing exactly 40 lowercase hex characters.

outputs.name: relayOrigin
outputs.description: Normalized URL origin, or null when the supplied address is missing or invalid.

outputs.name: relaySocketUrl
outputs.description: Matching ws or wss URL ending in /v1/hosts/{hostId}/connect, without credentials.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Invalid relay address when the origin or host ID is invalid.
